cancellationPolicies.label: Free Cancellation rates
cancellationPolicies.description: If you cancel your booking before 23:59 11th Dec 2025 (AWST) your deposit will be refunded to your payment card. If you cancel after 23:59 11th Dec 2025 (AWST) or in the event of a no-show, your deposit will not be refunded and the total of the first night's accommodation will be charged to your payment card, unless otherwise stated (see 'Things to Note' information). Please note that cancellations must be made directly within your booking in My Account.

privates.name: Standard Double Bed Private Shared Bathroom
privates.description: In order to secure a Private Room, you will need to book the entire room.
privates.labelDescription: Private room with triplex bunk (double bed with single bunk over the top) - PLEASE NOTE shared bathroom. Nightly rate includes 1-2 guests. Additional guest is charged at $25 p/n. Linen provided. Budget accommodation just footsteps to the Ningaloo Reef.

Your deposit will be non-refundable unless the Standard Flexible Booking option is available and you select it. T&C apply.
